target_customer: Startup founders (free tier), with investors and advisors as the users who contribute, and paid email tooling for founders
problem: Founders get little help from investors and advisors because asks and updates are scattered across email, and investors do not know how to help.
business_model: freemium SaaS; paid Cabal Mail Pro at 19 dollars per user per month
product_category: Investor relations and founder investor collaboration workspace, now an investor update email tool

founders.name: Fahim Ferdous
founders.background_notes: Employers from the YC page; AdQuick co-founder per Forbes May 2022. CB Insights lists him as a former founder and CTO. Education not found.

founders.name: Brian Murray
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder by Forbes and Product Hunt, not by the YC page. Education not found.

founders.name: Varun Rustomji
founders.background_notes: Listed only on Product Hunt as a cofounder of the March launch; not confirmed elsewhere.

competitors.name: Visible.vc
competitors.what: Investor update and investor relations platform for founders
competitors.funding_then: not stated; sources conflict on funding

competitors.name: AngelList
competitors.what: Company and fund management and investor tooling for startups

technical_complexity.rationale: A workspace for asks and updates plus email and CRM features is ordinary web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Value could grow if investors and founders joined the same workspace, but updates and intros tooling was simple to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition or copying found in sources.

market_need_then: Founders and investors both said investor help was unstructured. Cabal began in early 2020 as a side project by a founder and a venture partner who wanted it for themselves, per Forbes.

branding.domain_note: Uses getcabal.com with the get prefix, so the exact .com was not used; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: A logo file only, no further description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Short confident headlines such as Easiest investor updates in email history.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt Launch of the Day on 2022-03-24 with 365 upvotes, hunted by Alexis Ohanian; a separate Cabal App launch on 2022-05-27.

brand_strength.rationale: Short memorable word but shared with many unrelated names such as TechCabal and a bookkeeping app; Product Hunt traction was solid, no wider brand evidence.

pivots.from: Private workspace for founders, investors and advisors
pivots.to: Investor update email tool with mail merge and tracking
pivots.why: Not stated; the current website shows the narrower email product, the date of change is unknown.

outcome_analysis: Cabal came from a side project between a founder and a Craft Ventures partner, raised an 8 million dollar seed in May 2022 led by Craft and Seven Seven Six, and won Launch of the Day on Product Hunt. Its distribution through investor networks helped, but the public product has since narrowed to an investor update email tool and Fahim Ferdous appears as a former founder in a database. The company is active with no exit.
notes: CB Insights reports only 130 thousand dollars raised over four rounds with a seed on 2021-08-31 and founded 2020 in Moraga; this conflicts with the Forbes 8 million figure and is treated as an incomplete aggregator entry. The YC page lists only Fahim Ferdous. Competitor list is from undated pages (Visible.vc site, Product Hunt alternatives page) and may include rivals that were not active in 2021. Founding year 2020 per Forbes (early 2020 side project) versus YC listing 2021.
